meaning:
φθιν-οπωρινός, -ή, -όν
(φθινόπωρον, late autumn),
autumnal: δένδρα φ., autumn trees (said to be without fruit therefore at a time when fruit might be expected; see Mayor's elaborate note, Ep. Ju., 55-59, and reff. there): Ju 12.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: These are hidden rocky reefs in your love feasts when they feast with you, shepherds who without fear feed themselves; clouds without water, carried along by…
